items.title: Items
items.subtitle: Materials and supplies tracked across locations

items.differentItem: ← Actually, this is a different item — register it separately

items.alreadyRegistered: Already registered — add to one of these instead?

items.moreDetailsHint: (unit, cost, reorder point, lead time, barcodes, notes)
items.dimensionsPlaceholder: e.g. 48in x 96in x 0.5in, or 1 gal, or Size L

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: Purchase orders, logged drop-offs, and discrepancies
orders.readyHint: Reviewed requests grouped by vendor, ready to become a real order — the worklist for Monday/Wednesday/Friday ordering.
orders.nothingReady: Nothing ready yet — review a request on the Requests page to add it here.
orders.selectionLockedToVendor: One vendor per order — selection locked to {{vendor}}.
orders.noOpenDiscrepancies: No open discrepancies — every delivery has checked out clean.
orders.nothingPending: Nothing pending — everything that's been placed has arrived.
orders.nothingFlagged: Nothing flagged — no arrived orders have an open discrepancy.
orders.onlineHint: Placed with a vendor, arriving later
orders.dropoffHint: Bought already, being logged and stored now
orders.attachPhotoOrPdf: Attach a photo or a PDF.
orders.couldntConfidentlyMatch: Couldn't confidently match any registered items in that file — add lines manually below.
orders.couldNotScanFile: Could not scan that file — enter items manually.
orders.foundPossibleMatches: Found {{count}} possible match(es) — check the qty and uncheck anything wrong, then add.
orders.addLeastOneLine: Add at least one line item.
orders.linesNeedItem: Pick or create a product for {{count}} line item(s) below (highlighted) before saving.
orders.lineNeedsItemHint: Pick a match above, or tap "+ Create new item" to add this to the catalog.
orders.chooseWherePurchased: Choose where it was purchased from.
orders.chooseWarehouseGoing: Choose which warehouse it's going to.
orders.receiptNumberRequired: Receipt number is required for a drop-off.
orders.expectedDateRequired: Expected arrival date is required for an online order.
orders.invoiceNumberRequired: Invoice number is required for an online order.
orders.deleteOrderConfirm: Delete order {{order}}? This can't be undone.
orders.closeOrderConfirm: This marks it as done even though it never reached the full ordered quantity. Only do this once you're sure nothing more is coming — for example, the vendor issued a credit instead of shipping the rest.
orders.closeOrderHint: Nothing more coming on this one? You can close it out without waiting for the rest to arrive.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitleWorker: Ask the Inventory Lead to order something you need
requests.subtitleLead: What the team's asked for — work through it in order
requests.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. 10 work lights, similar to the ones on truck 3
requests.cancelConfirm: Withdraw this request? This can't be undone.
requests.multiSelectHint: Tick the reviewed requests you want on one order — all from the same vendor — then use "Create Order" above.
requests.noneYet: You haven't asked for anything yet.
requests.reviewSectionTitle: Review — a request can't be ordered until vendor, item and link are set
requests.vendorRequired: Pick the vendor this will be bought from.
requests.itemRequired: Pick or create the catalog item this maps to.
requests.projectNoteHelper: A plain description of the job — handy if you don't have the Estimate # confirmed yet. You can come back and fix the number above later.

counts.title: Counts
counts.subtitle: Check what's actually there against what the system expects
counts.nothingTracked: Nothing tracked at this location yet.
counts.howItWorks: Walk around and check off each item as you count it. We've already filled in what the system expects — if that's what you see, just tick the box. If it's different, type in the number you actually counted instead.
counts.checkAtLeastOne: Check off at least one item first.
counts.confirmSummaryWithMismatches: You checked {{checked}} item(s). {{mismatched}} didn't match what the system expected — those will be corrected when you save.
counts.confirmSummaryAllMatch: You checked {{checked}} item(s) and everything matched. Nothing needs to change.
counts.savedAllMatched: Saved — everything matched, nothing needed fixing.
